moa: Locally acting corticosteroid targeting the gut-associated lymphoid tissue (Peyer's patches)

launch_evidence.quote: In January 2022, Calliditas announced commercial availability and initial sales of TARPEYO (budesonide) delayed release capsules, the first and only FDA approved treatment for IgA nephropathy

series_end_reason: Calliditas was acquired by Asahi Kasei through a tender offer (SC TO-T filings by Asahi Kasei, 2024); its last interim report on sec.gov is the six-month report furnished on Form 6-K on 2024-08-13 (calt-20240630x6k.htm). It then filed Form 25 (2024-09-13), Form 25-NSE (2024-09-20) and Form 15F-12B (2024-09-23, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1795579/000110465924102072/tm2424569d1_15f12b.htm), terminating its SEC registration; no third-quarter 2024 report is on sec.gov.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1795579 (Calliditas Therapeutics AB) via data.sec.gov/submissions; all 6-K and 20-F filings from 2022-01-01 to deregistration searched (every document in each filing's index.json except XBRL viewer pages) for 'tarpeyo'.

Quarterly interim reports are furnished on Form 6-K (Exhibit 99.1); each quarter is read from that quarter's own report, key-figures sentence 'Net sales amounted to SEK x million, of which TARPEYO net sales amounted to SEK y million, for the three months ended ...'. The reports do print net sales per quarter, including the fourth quarter (year-end report).

Checks: 2022 quarters 18.0+63.6+123.4+167.3 = 372.3 vs 'TARPEYO net sales amounted to SEK 372.2 million' for the year ended December 31, 2022 (year-end report 2024-02-21), within rounding; 2023 quarters 185.7+259.2+283.6+347.3 = 1,075.8 = 'TARPEYO net sales amounted to SEK 1,075.8 million, for the year ended December 31, 2023'. Six-month figures agree: 18.0+63.6 = 81.6 and 278.3+493.4 = 771.7 vs 771.6.
Values are in SEK, the currency the reports state; not converted.
